description: Fleet-shape response check for COVID-RINGCAP-V1: coarse generic-voyage cells at the five THETA-SCREEN-V15 admissible Thetas under the same two arms as the parent replay assay. Rings-first budgeting shrinks the pooled cohort by the fixed-ring spend, so the fleet-shape medians are expected to sag below their v15 rows -- this design measures the direction and magnitude class of that shift at 50 seeds per row. It is NOT a re-admission: 50-seed medians at the band points answer 'did the band move' and point a follow-on re-screen where to look; they carry no selector verdict and no Theta is admitted from this surface.
prerequisites: covid_ring_cap_v1 (parent): the clause-response replay assay this fleet check accompanies -- same arms, same image, same campaign submission.

THETA-SCREEN-V15 measured (6efec855) under the repaired once_per_course presentation draw: the admissible band {1.78e11..5.62e11} this response check is centered on (identical coordinates to the v13 band); the v15 stage-1 rows at these Thetas (s3 prefix campaign/covid_theta_screen_v15/6efec855/cells/) are the comparator of record.
voyage_mode_note: Generic voyages verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v15 stage 1 (the same frozen grammar, carried since v13): the explicit seed's onset_day/departure_day are dropped, its infection age is drawn from the profile's incubation distribution, 168 epochs, no interventions, the scenario's molecular_ascertainment_start_day dropped (a DP particular) so the modality's default swab channel stays open from embarkation. Carried: imports 1, dwell_weighted sanitary visits.
thetas_note: The five v15 admissible interior points verbatim (the same lattice coordinates v13 measured) -- no boundary or anchor rows: the question is how the measured band points move under the arm, not where the new band's edges sit.
infection_age_note: Placeholder required by the cell enumeration grammar, verbatim from v13: under generic mode the import's age is drawn per voyage and age0d carries no meaning.
seeds_note: First 50 of the v15 stage-1 seed block (base 20201001, the same frozen block used since v13) so every fleet cell pairs seed-for-seed with the first 50 v15 cells at the same Theta -- coarse (50-seed) read by declaration; a band re-screen under the arm is a separate design if the parent's verdict calls for one.

arms.note: v15 baseline arm -- seed-for-seed pairing against the v15 stage-1 rows (the drift audit: a no-override arm must reproduce the parent cells on the same engine revision).
Fixed-ring deals spend the shedder's per-epoch budget first (RING-CAP-V1).

cells_note: 5 Thetas x 2 arms x 50 seeds = 500 generic cells (~7 min each).

admissibility.note: FROZEN: the fleet_shape_selector numbers are quoted verbatim for reporting only -- no row on this design is admitted or rejected. The readout reports median attack rate, IQR, takeoff fraction, P(attack >= 0.10) per (theta, arm) beside the v15 row, and the paired per-seed deltas between arms.
admissibility.fleet_shape_selector_report_only: median recorded attack rate in [0.0005, 0.008], IQR overlapping [0.0003, 0.015], mean <= 0.06 -- reported as in/out per row arm, never as a selection verdict: the coarse seed count does not re-admit anything.

execution.platform: AWS Batch via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_ring_cap_v1_fleet, on the same image as the parent design. Convention: submit to the On-Demand queue picard-analysis-queue (CE picard-analysis-compute-ondemand, max 256 vCPU) -- us-east-1 Spot droughts park arrays >1h at RUNNABLE and are not job errors.
execution.canary: First row on both arms: INDEX_OFFSET 0, ARRAY_SIZE 100 covers Theta 1.78e11 x 2 arms x 50 seeds (cell order point x arm x seed: cap_on = 0-49, rings_first = 50-99) -- flag-lands proof plus contract integrity. Remaining rows proceed on a clean read per the campaign gate.
execution.report_immediately_if: an arm row's median lands more than one lattice notch from its v15 comparator in EITHER direction (mechanism moves the band more than expected -- the parent's clause read needs the shifted band); the rings_first arm's audit echo lacks include_fixed_rings resolved true (flag did not reach the engine); or child failure rate exceeds 5%.
